metadata.name: LoyaltyPointsManagement
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to manage the loyalty points with respect to Add/Reduce/Redeem for the Account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card holder's Account Number. Valid Values:0-9 Example:8000000000000037 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Account id) Valid Values:0-9 Example:82432455 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: To decide if Loyalty points needs to Add or Remove Valid Values: 0 = Add Loyalty Points 1 = Reduce Loyalty Points 2 = Redeem Loyalty Points Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: LoyaltyProgramID
request_fields.description: ID of Loyalty Program Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:2345(Value shared by CoreCard).

request_fields.name: ValueofLoyaltyPoint
request_fields.description: The value of loyalty points to Add/Reduce/Redeem for the Account. Valid Values:0-9 Example:150.50

request_fields.name: BankAccountNumber
request_fields.description: This tag represents the Bank Account number / Method Name of the payment bank for the following redemption method: 1 = ACH. For the  9 = 'LoanPayDown' redemption method, this tag must contain the Loan ID to identify the loan account for loyalty points redemption. Valid Values:0-9 Example:123654214556 Condition: It is mandatory for 1 = ACH and 9 = LoanPayDown Redemption Method. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: RedemptionMethod
request_fields.description: Method by which loyalty points will be redeemed for the Account. Valid Values : 1 = ACH 3 = Statement Credit 5 = Partner Pay 9 = LoanPayDown Example:1 Condition: The 'RedemptionMethod' field is required when DecisionFlag = 2 (Redeem Loyalty Points). Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: LoanPayDown
request_fields.description: Indicates whether Loyalty Points should be applied to loan payment. Valid Values:0-No and 1-Yes Example : 1 Condition: The 'LoanPayDown' field is required and must be set to 1 when RedemptionMethod = 9 (Loan Pay Down). Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: Notes
request_fields.description: The note capture by the user. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example : This is a test note Allowable Values: 1800

request_fields.name: ExternalReference
request_fields.description: The field can accommodate various types of client-specific identifiers or references relevant to loyalty points transactions, which can be included in RewardsActivity DF. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example : REF123 Allowable Values: 128

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded. Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking. Example:7485122
